# Subway Seat for Vivaldi

Toolbars and panels on the flavor's base, the window frame one step deeper, and burnt orange for the active tab and focus. Vivaldi works out readable text on the accent by itself.

[Vivaldi](https://vivaldi.com) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/vivaldi/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat/settings.json`](subway-seat/settings.json) | inside the theme zip |
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.zip`](subway-seat.zip) | Settings → Themes → Library → Import Theme |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel/settings.json`](subway-seat-tunnel/settings.json) | inside the theme zip |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.zip`](subway-seat-tunnel.zip) | Settings → Themes → Library → Import Theme |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel/settings.json`](subway-seat-enamel/settings.json) | inside the theme zip |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.zip`](subway-seat-enamel.zip) | Settings → Themes → Library → Import Theme |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in Vivaldi → Settings → Themes → Library:

```text
Import Theme → subway-seat.zip
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in Vivaldi → Settings → Themes → Library:

```text
Import Theme → subway-seat-tunnel.zip
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in Vivaldi → Settings → Themes → Library:

```text
Import Theme → subway-seat-enamel.zip
```


Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py`. Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
